subtitle.zh: 从凸点到板级可靠性，把电、热、力放在同一验证窗口中
subtitle.en: From bumps to board-level reliability, evaluate electrical, thermal and mechanical behavior within one validation window

body.zh: 封装 → 凸点 → 基板布线 → 装配对准 → 板级可靠性。任何一环失配都会阻断交付。
body.en: Packaging → bumps → substrate routing → assembly alignment → board-level reliability. A mismatch in any link blocks delivery.

body.zh: 依靠芯片边缘焊盘和金属线连接，成熟且灵活。图中标出芯片、Wire Bond与I/O。当I/O数、信号频率和供电电流上升时，导线长度、寄生电感和封装高度开始占用系统余量。
body.en: Wire bonding uses die-edge pads and metal wires and is mature and flexible. The illustration labels the die, Wire Bond and I/O. As I/O count, signal frequency and supply current increase, wire length, parasitic inductance and package height begin consuming system margins.

body.zh: 凸点连接封装与基板，传递电与热。凸点失配会导致电气或机械失效。
body.en: Bumps connect the package and substrate and transfer electricity and heat. Bump mismatch causes electrical or mechanical failure.

body.zh: 基板布线在基板内完成信号与电源分配，影响完整性与热扩散。布线失配会引入信号与供电问题。
body.en: Substrate routing distributes signals and power within the substrate and affects integrity and heat spreading. Routing mismatch introduces signal and power-delivery problems.

body.zh: 装配对准保证封装与基板的空间对准，建立可靠连接。对准失配会导致连接不良或开路。
body.en: Assembly alignment ensures spatial alignment between the package and substrate and establishes reliable connections. Alignment mismatch causes poor connections or opens.

body.zh: 热量从芯片经封装与基板传导，影响整机可靠性。热路径失配会引发过热与长期可靠性风险。
body.en: Heat conducts from the die through the package and substrate, affecting system reliability. Thermal-path mismatch causes overheating and long-term reliability risks.

body.zh: 电气性能、热管理和机械可靠性共同进入验证。任一环节失配 → 阻断交付；目标是系统稳定、整机可靠、成功交付。
body.en: Electrical performance, thermal management and mechanical reliability are validated together. Any link mismatches → delivery is blocked. The goals are a stable system, reliable complete system and successful delivery.
